_comment: rootfs_bytes_max is the BLOCKING per-board content ceiling, not the frozen 4096M ext4 slot size. The universal 1500000000-byte placeholder is retired for RK3588 full-firmware adoption: both boards use 3500000000, x86 remains 1500000000. Budget review uses wet per-board measurements and stays below the frozen slot minus 536870912 bytes; actual populated-slot bavail and inode reserves are checked independently. Planning estimates authorize no artifact. See docs/bluetooth-firmware-closure.md. Keys beginning with '_' are metadata, not board entries.

_baked_binaries._comment: Non-apt binaries fetched + staged into the rootfs at build time (postinst-lib.sh), recorded here so the per-board rootfs_bytes_max headroom stays auditable. bytes = staged binary size measured 2026-07-02; all comfortably under the 1.5 GB ceiling. Metadata only — NOT a board entry (measure-size.sh ignores '_'-prefixed keys).

mediamtx.note: RTMP ingest gateway (Todo 14). Per-arch static Go binary; ~52 MiB (amd64) / ~59 MiB (arm64). The plan estimated ~30 MB; the real measured delta is recorded here.

_measurement_note: `measured` records the real override-free OS 2026.10.95/.96 mainline/full-firmware candidate rootfs.tar apparent bytes, byte-identical to ci/size-baseline.<board>.json. Both are non-debug, use production PARTLABELs and a non-production RAUC signer; no fleet or full hardware qualification is implied. Growth is not attributed; provenance and justification are in docs/size-notes.md section 4. Absolute ceilings and slot-reserve gates are unchanged. x86-minipc has no wet build yet, so it stays null.
